notes.title: 🚀 Drone Dash Early Access 0.3.0 Release 🚀
notes.content:
We’re excited to launch [b]Drone Dash 0.3.0[/b] to early access! This build represents a major milestone packed with new features, quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and tons of new content to explore. Here’s a sneak peek at some of what’s new:

[h2]🌟 Major Updates:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*][b]New Levels Galore[/b]: Overhauled the first 6 levels with vibrant color themes and added 13+ new levels to the learn to fly campaign!
[*][b]Demo Mode[/b]: Added demo exports, config tweaks, and support.  
[*][b]New Tutorials[/b]: Tutorials now include instructions on charge pads, fire rainers, and gate mechanics.  
[/list]  

[h2]🎨 Visual & Audio Enhancements:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*][b]Revamped Visual Theme[/b]: Overhauled the game’s visual theme to be cleaner and more refined.  
[*][b]Improved Editor UI[/b]: Enhanced positioning, button layouts, and new control_node picker functionality.  
[*][b]Audio Improvements[/b]: Added new music tracks, sound effects, and fixed background music transitions.  
[/list]  

[h2]🛠️ Quality of Life Improvements:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*][b]Preset Manager[/b]: New preset editor and manager to customize your experience.  
[*][b]Editor Enhancements[/b]: Editor objects can now be locked, recently used colors persist, and tab order is saved between sessions.  
[*][b]Fixes Galore[/b]: Resolved crashes, path follower bugs, drone effects, and editor glitches for smoother gameplay.  
[/list]  

[h2]⚡ Gameplay Features:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*][b]Interactive Elements[/b]: Introduced spikes, shocker, charge-pad single-use support, and landing pad improvements.  
[*][b]Paint Tool[/b]: A new paint system to customize in-game objects.  
[*][b]Drag-and-Drop Functionality[/b]: Easily drag items from the game objects panel to the level tree for quick level editing.  
[/list]  

[h2]🌐 Cloud Sync & Steam Workshop:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*][b]Cloud Sync[/b]: Updated paths for cloud sync and improved appdata handling.  
[*][b]NOTE[/b]: This change caused us to reset your savegame data.  
[*][b]Workshop Integration[/b]: Added support for sharing and exploring custom content.  
[/list]  

We can’t wait for you to dive in, try the new levels, and share your feedback with us. Thank you for being a part of the journey as we continue to make Drone Dash a fun racing experience for all!

notes.title: 📢 Patch 0.2.0 Now Live! 🎉
notes.content:
[h1]🛠️ What's New in v0.2.0?[/h1]
[h2]✨ Major Features[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Level Editor[/b]: Create, edit, and test your own custom campaigns with our new Campaign Editor.
[*][b]Deterministic Physics Engine:[/b] We’ve swapped the old physics engine with a deterministic one, ensuring consistency across replays and leaderboards.
[/list]

[h2]🎮 Gameplay Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Out of Bounds Penalty: Drones now drain their battery when leaving the map.
[*] New Obstacle – Spike: Beware of spikes that instantly drain your drone’s power on collision!
[/list]

[h2]🔧 Settings Overhaul[/h2]
[list]
[*] Graphics Options: Added FPS limit and graphics settings for better performance customization.
[*] Fullscreen Improvements: Fullscreen modes now honor your saved settings.
[/list]

[h2]📋 UI Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Goal Times: Displayed above the level preview to set clear targets.
[*] Consistent Time Formatting: Times are now formatted as h:mm:ss.xxx for clarity.
[*] Campaign Select Improvements: Level info is hidden until a campaign is selected.
[*] Replay Enhancements: The "Play Again" button now works seamlessly after watching a replay.
[/list]

[h2]📦 Platform Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] SteamOS Builds: We’re thrilled to announce support for SteamOS, now available through Steam!
[/list]

[h2]🏁 Leaderboard Reset[/h2]
[list]
[*] Due to the physics engine change, all leaderboards have been reset for a fair and fresh start. Let’s see who climbs to the top!
[/list]

[h2]🔨 Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] Recreated all existing levels using the new Campaign Editor.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We can’t wait to see the levels you create! 🎨🚁

Let us know what you think, and as always, happy racing!
